_comment: 🦌 BlankTB Portal Backend Egg for Pelican/Pterodactyl Panel
name: BlankTB Portal Backend 🦌
author: Blank The Deer <support@blanktb.net>
description: FastAPI backend for the BlankTB Portal — with MongoDB, ReCAPTCHA, Discord webhooks, and pastel deer vibes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
\
set -e
\
echo '🦌 Installing BlankTB Portal Backend...'
\
apt update -y && apt install -y git python3-venv
\
cd /home/container
\
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
\
  echo '📦 Cloning repository...'
\
  git clone "$GIT_CLONE_URL" .
\
else
\
  echo '🔁 Repo already exists — pulling latest changes...'
\
  git pull
\
fi
\
echo '🐍 Creating virtual environment...'
\
python3 -m venv .venv
\
source .venv/bin/activate
\
pip install --upgrade pip
\
pip install -r requirements.txt
\
echo '✅ Installation complete. Remember to create your .env file!'

variables.name: GIT_CLONE_URL
variables.description: Full HTTPS clone URL to your private backend repo (include PAT if needed).
